summary: This lesson plan aims to help students understand the importance of respecting other cultural identity while retaining one's culture. It uses a 1-Minute Frozen Tableau Drama approach to facilitate active learning and collaboration. Students will work in teams to explore a real-world Sri Lankan scenario, take civic roles, and agree on a reasoned decision. The lesson will help students develop their critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills while promoting cultural awareness and understanding.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Students will be assessed on their participation, active listening, and role execution. Feedback will be provided through peer evaluation and self-reflection.
